    • getBroadcastSubscriberMap

      public static Map<ShadowStatsManager.BroadcastSubscriberKey, PendingIntent> getBroadcastSubscriberMap()
      Retrieves the broadcast subscriber map stored in the shadow as a result of
      invalid reference 
      StatsManager#setBroadcastSubscriber()
      .
      Returns:
      A map where the keys are ShadowStatsManager.BroadcastSubscriberKey objects, which contain the configKey and subscriberId, and the values are PendingIntent objects.
